content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"In-home personal care and home health services, not owning or leasing healthcare real estate to tenants."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Leases radiosurgery equipment on per-use fees to hospitals, not real estate leased for rent."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare workforce staffing and software, earning placement fees rather than property rent."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"In-home pediatric and adult nursing services paid by government programs, with no property leasing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Operates senior living communities and collects resident fees, rather than owning and leasing properties to operators."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate and government tenants, not senior housing or medical properties."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Installs and maintains building mechanical and electrical systems for fees, not a property owner earning rent."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Contracted physician staffing for hospitals, billed to payers, with no real estate ownership or leasing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases corporate office buildings, a different property type and tenant base from healthcare real estate."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Operates skilled nursing and senior living sites and earns care revenue, rather than leasing properties to operators."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Runs a hotel and apartment rentals plus securities investing, with different property types and customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Earns management fees by running REITs and properties for them, not by owning and leasing properties directly."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Operates acute care and behavioral hospitals delivering patient care, not leasing property to tenants."}]}
